title: Periodica
description: A mod that improves certain aspects of chemistry, much of it based on real-life chemistry.
body:
# !Alpha version! 
The mod doesn't add much content yet because it's in alpha.
- The mod adds new ore, some electronics, armor and tools, as well as blocks.
- There are plans to develop the mod and add a lot of content.
- There are still a lot of things without functionality.
- You can find information about some items in the gallery.
- I try to make the mod as realistic as possible.

A mod that improves certain aspects of chemistry, much of it based on real-life chemistry.
Some ingots can't be obtained simply by smelting them in a furnace; chemical reactions are required. Update 0.0.4 added a workbench where you can upgrade your equipment (currently, only steel and titanium armor can be upgraded, and only with tungsten).

Since work on JEI support is still ongoing, I decided to release a video with crafts:
https://youtu.be/uQAWAE1oecY
